summary: keywords auto-promote must accept --bid-amount and --currency flags; hardcoded 0.50 USD bid breaks non-USD accounts and prevents bid customization.
reason: ASA API rejects keyword creation where bidAmount.currency does not match the org's billing currency; non-USD accounts always received a 400 on promote. Also derived startTime/endTime at runtime (90-day lookback); the hardcoded 2099-12-31 endTime caused 400 errors on the search-terms report request.
